**Pro at RStudio but would benefit from more resources? It is easier than ever to launch at RStudio Instance on Hyak.**

::: callout-note
see also: <https://hyak.uw.edu/docs/ood/start>
:::

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Access Dashboard

Go to <https://ondemand.hyak.uw.edu/pun/sys/dashboard/>

<img src="http://gannet.fish.washington.edu/seashell/snaps/Monosnap_Dashboard_-_Hyak_OnDemand_2025-05-01_11-59-05.png" width="300"/>

Click on Interactive Apps

<img src="http://gannet.fish.washington.edu/seashell/snaps/Monosnap_Dashboard_-_Hyak_OnDemand_2025-05-01_11-59-40.png" width="300"/>

# Selecting Resources

Decide on what specific resources are available and needed.

You will be then be asked for information on resources you will ask for.

<img src="http://gannet.fish.washington.edu/seashell/snaps/Monosnap_RStudio_-_Hyak_OnDemand_2025-05-01_12-04-18.png" width="300"/>

If you this is the first experience with Klone you it might be good to get familar with what resources are available to you.

For this you can login to Klone at command line from this webpage by clicking on `>_Klone Login` and entering your credentials. From there you can run command `hyakalloc` to see what resources you have access to.

<img src="http://gannet.fish.washington.edu/seashell/snaps/Monosnap_RStudio_-_Hyak_OnDemand_2025-05-01_12-07-21.png" width="600"/>

## Custom Container

One real value here is that customized Container files can you used.

See repo directory for list of files.

If you want to get started fast and are genomic inclined, feel free to use

`/gscratch/srlab/containers/srlab-R4.4-bioinformatics-container-a83e518.sif`

Which loads

| Program Name | Version | Installation Method | Notes |
|------------------|------------------|------------------|------------------|
| Apptainer | 1.4.0 | .deb package (dpkg) | Required for Nextflow/nf-core support |
| bedtools | v2.31.0 | Binary download | Installed as bedtools.static |
| Bismark | 0.24.2 | Source (zip) | Requires Bowtie2 |
| Bowtie2 | 2.5.4 | Binary (zip) | -sra-linux-x86_64 version |
| DIAMOND | 2.1.9 | Binary (tar.gz) | diamond-linux64 |
| fastp | 0.23.4 | Binary download | Direct binary download from opengene.org |
| FastQC | 0.12.1 | Binary (zip) | Renamed to fastqc-${version}
gffcompare | 0.12.6 | Binary (tar.gz) | From StringTie site
HISAT2 | 2.2.1 | Source (make) | Compiled from source
kallisto | 0.51.1 | Source (cmake, make) | Compiled in a build directory
Miniforge (mamba) | 24.7.1-0 | Installer script (bash) | Used for Python + conda/mamba-based installs
MultiQC | 1.24.1 | Installed via mamba | In multiqc_env conda environment
Nextflow | Latest | Script (curl) | Installed via official bootstrap method
NCBI Datasets CLI | 13.34.0 | Binary (zip) | Extracted to ncbi-datasets-v${version} directory |
| NCBI BLAST+ | 2.16.0 | Binary (tar.gz) | Downloaded from NCBI FTP |
| RepeatMasker | 4.1.7-p1 | Source (tar.gz) | Requires local DB (famdb); symlinks set to Klone’s installation |
| RMBLAST | 2.14.1 | Binary (tar.gz) | From RepeatMasker.org |
| salmon | 1.10.0 | Binary (tar.gz) | Installed from GitHub release |
| samtools | 1.20 | Source (configure, make) | Compiled locally |
| StringTie | 2.2.1 | Binary (tar.gz) | Downloaded from StringTie website |
| Trimmomatic | 0.39 | Binary (zip) | Java-based, unzipped and made executable |
| TRF (Tandem Repeats Finder) | 4.09.1 | Binary (github) | Named trf409.linux64, marked executable |

## Leveraging ckpt as resource

If you only need instance running \< 5 hours one might say best practices would be to use `ckpt`. `ckpt` are unused resources by larger UW community thus not using your own group shared resources. However you will get kicked off at around 5 hours.

<img src="http://gannet.fish.washington.edu/seashell/snaps/Monosnap_RStudio_-_Hyak_OnDemand_2025-05-01_15-29-53.png" width="300"/>

## Compute Parameters

You then need to select tasks, cpus, and memory

<img src="http://gannet.fish.washington.edu/seashell/snaps/Monosnap_RStudio_-_Hyak_OnDemand_2025-05-01_15-32-44.png" width="300"/>

# Launch and Connect

The instance in Launched and then you click on "Connect to RStudio Server".

<img src="http://gannet.fish.washington.edu/seashell/snaps/Monosnap_My_Interactive_Sessions_-_Hyak_OnDemand_2025-05-01_15-35-03.png" width="500"/>
